name: Tirupati

sources.title: Mandals | TIRUPATI DISTRICT, Government of Andhra Pradesh
Restructuring of SPSR Nellore District and Tirupati District - Final Notification [G.O.Ms.No.525, Revenue (Lands-IV), 30 Dec 2025] (AP Gazette Extraordinary No. 956)
Tirupati sheds Gudur and embraces Kodur, while Kadapa gets back Rajampeta - The Hindu
A.P. Cabinet clears district reorganisation, mandal realignment - The Hindu

notes: The official mandals page (36 mandals, 3 divisions) already reflects the Dec 2025 changes: the Railway Kodur constituency mandals (Koduru, Penagalur, Chitvel, Pullampeta, Obulavaripalle) were added from Annamayya into Tirupati division; Gudur, Chillakur and Kota went back to SPSR Nellore; Vakadu and Chittamur now sit in Sullurpet division. This matches The Hindu (31 Dec 2025) and the SPSR Nellore official page. The page has no 'last updated' date, and /revenue-divisions/ returned 404, so the divisions come from the Divison column of the mandals table. Mandal and division spellings follow the official page (e.g. 'Srikalahasthi', 'Sullurpet'); ULB names follow CDMA ('Srikalahasti', 'Sullurupeta'). CDMA grades Srikalahasti as Grade I and Naidupeta, Puttur, Sullurupeta and Venkatagiri as Grade III. Koduru is not listed as a ULB by CDMA.
